BiblicalUsage: No man is to despise Timothy's youth; he is to be an example in word and conduct, and Paul appeals to his manner of life from his youth among his own nation at Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe youth is no excuse and no barrier: Timothy must be an example while he is young, and Paul's life from his youth is the proof that God uses the young.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
